audit_item:
Make sure power is OFF or disconnected before servicing.
1) Clean up trash around area, wipe up and grease or spills.
2) Using wipes and warm soapy water, clean external surfaces of machine.

Machine should be on for this part of servicing.
1) While machine is cycling, press E-Stop. The machine should immediately stop, pull button back up to reset.

Machine power should be OFF or disconnected before servicing. 
1) Cleaning film saver pre-stretch roller
   - Do NOT use acetone to clean rollers or they will be damaged
   - Push knob down to open roller door, thoroughly clean roller with wipes and isopropyl alcohol. Close door when finished.
2) Cleaning Photo Sensor
   - Spray small amount of window cleaning solution to face of photo eye, then dry photo eye with cleaning wipe.

Machine power should be OFF or disconnected before servicing.
1) Greasing center shaft bearing
  - Apply one pump of grease (grease gun with No.2 Grade Lithium Grease) to the grease fitting, then wipe fitting clean.

Machine power should be OFF or disconnected before servicing.
1) Checking Turntable Drive Chain Tension
  - Loosen bolt.
  - Turn nut until you begin to feel resistance of chain tightener against the chain, then turn another 30 degrees.
  - While holding nut still, tighten bolt. Do NOT overtighten chain, machine will get damaged if you do.
2) Check Fasteners for Tightness
  - Check all exterior fasteners for tightness, tighten as required.
3) Grease Carriage Lift Chain
  - Appy a thin film of grease (No.2 lithium grease) to the lift chain, then wipe any excess grease.

LP-SRT High/Low Profile
1) Test operation & adjust carriage safety switch as required
2) Inspect & tighten set screws of pre-stretch roller bearings
3) Lubricate & adjust tension of pre-stretch chains
4) Inspect & tighten set-screws pre-stretch sprockets

LP-SRT High/Low Profile
1) Inspect turntable support rollers
2) Lubricate & adjust tension of turntable drive chain
3) Inspect & tighten set screws on turntable gear reducer sprocket
4) Inspect, check or adjust sensing distance of 1PX turntable pulse prox. sensor, tighten locking nuts if required
5)  Inspect, check or adjust sensing distance of 5PX carriage pulse prox. sensor, tighten locking nuts if required
6) Lubricate & adjust tension of carriage lift chain
7) Inspect & tighten mounting/ set screws of carriage lift sprockets
8) Inspect carriage limit switch arms
